name: Credential Brute-Force and Stuffing Against Authentication Endpoints

sigma_auth_log.title: Authentication Brute-Force / Credential Stuffing
sigma_auth_log.description: Detects brute-force and credential stuffing patterns. Based on TTP analysis: credential_attack appears in 40/168 (24%) of mined SG security accounts. Escalated threat because agent-hivemind vault system (Shamir + Redis) is designed to store harvested credentials from compromised Claude Code sessions.
sigma_auth_log.author: SocioProphet/SCOPE-D

detection.condition: selection_auth_endpoint and selection_failure | count() by c-ip > 10

falsepositives: Automated integration tests — add CI IP to allowlist
Misconfigured mobile app repeatedly retrying failed auth

sigma_github_auth.title: GitHub Actions Credential in Environment or Logs
sigma_github_auth.description: Detects accidental credential exposure in GitHub Actions logs — a common vector given the agent-hivemind vault targeting developers.

osquery_network.description: Detect credential attack tools running locally (hydra, medusa, patator, hashcat against remote targets)
osquery_network.query: SELECT p.pid, p.name, p.cmdline, p.start_time, u.username FROM processes p JOIN users u ON p.uid = u.uid WHERE p.name IN ('hydra', 'medusa', 'patator', 'hashcat', 'john', 'spray', 'credmaster') OR p.cmdline LIKE '%hydra%' OR p.cmdline LIKE '%credential-stuffing%' ORDER BY p.start_time DESC LIMIT 10;

github_secret_scanning.description: Enable GitHub secret scanning push protection on all SocioProphet org repos. Blocks commits containing: GitHub tokens, AWS keys, Anthropic API keys, private keys, generic secrets matching common patterns.

rate_limit_auth.description: Auth endpoint rate limiting: >5 failures from single IP in 60s → lockout challenge. >20 → block 1h. Account-level: >3 failures → require MFA step-up.

expectedEffect: Detect and throttle brute-force and credential stuffing attacks before account compromise. Critical in context of agent-hivemind's credential vault — if an attacker harvests credentials from a Claude Code session via hook injection (det-sg-hivemind-hook-injection-001), they will subsequently attempt to use those credentials. This detection closes that downstream loop.
falsePositiveRisk: LOW for Sigma auth log rule — 10+ failures in 5 min from one IP is unambiguous brute-force. LOW for GitHub secret scanning. MEDIUM for osquery (legitimate security testing tools may match).
deploymentGate: Deploy GitHub secret scanning immediately (zero false positive risk, push-protection only blocks actual secrets). Auth rate limiting needs baseline first. Sigma rule deploy immediately.
rollbackPlan: Secret scanning: if legitimate automation is blocked, add secret patterns to exclusion list with documented justification. Auth rate limiting: raise threshold if CI integration tests are blocked.
